tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · FY2027 Estimated Tax
tasks.description: Plan the FY2027 federal estimated tax (July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027) of HANGS Construction Services LLC from 6 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Test the large-corporation rule, build the Publication 542 worksheet that replaced Form 1120-W with the NOL deduction at its 80% limit, use last year’s tax for the 1st installment only, work the annualized income installment method as Form 2220 Schedule A does, apply the FY2026 overpayment credit and the payments made so far, and preview the underpayment penalty. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and a draft plan with the remaining payments and an EFTPS schedule. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and a draft estimated tax plan PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
